race.comment: MAIN ACT (1) improved sharply on his fourth two starts back with success over 1300m at this track two weeks ago. Draw presents some potential issues, but expecting him to hold his form now that he's at peak fitness. STREAK OF GOD (7) is also drawn out, but Willie Pike has overcome that countless times here and he does look one of the more progressive types in the race. COSMIC WALTZ (8) might have forgotten how to win but it's still hard to be too critical given he hasn't missed a place in five runs this prep. ALLENTOWN (5) finished third at this track two runs back but was less effective last time over 1400m at this track, finishing 3.5 lengths back in sixth. Nicely placed to make amends. CLASSIC IMPACT (9) is hard to tip with confidence given the last two efforts, but she's drawn low here, which was the case in the good first-up run.
